title: Expo push notifications troubleshooting and FAQ — delivery guarantees
observation: Expo documents best-effort handoff with possible duplicated or missing deliveries; a receipt is a handoff result, not proof of device receipt.
scope: Newly inspected for RC-04; not a re-audit of the original 42 sources.

title: Expo — Send notifications with the Expo Push Service
observation: Tickets/receipts and documented collapse/tag options have different semantics; receipt ok does not establish device receipt.
scope: Verify chosen SDK/transport exposes a documented capability before relying on it.

title: Apple — Sending notification requests to APNs
observation: APNs is best effort; collapse identifiers merge requests and do not supply an end-to-end exactly-once contract for the app database and device.
scope: Supports delivery limitation; proposed database/unknown-outcome policy is our design decision, not an Apple requirement.
